name: Epson EcoTank L3210 Ink Tank All-in-One Color Printer Black
shortDescription: Epson EcoTank L3210 All-in-One Color Ink Tank Printer (Print / Scan / Copy / Micro Piezo Technology / Up to 5760 x 1440 dpi / 33 ppm Black & 15 ppm Color Print Speed / 100-Sheet Input Tray / Hi-Speed USB 2.0 / High Y
descriptionHtml:
Epson EcoTank L3210 All-in-One Color Ink Tank Printer (Print / Scan / Copy / Micro Piezo Technology / Up to 5760 x 1440 dpi / 33 ppm Black & 15 ppm Color Print Speed / 100-Sheet Input Tray / Hi-Speed USB 2.0 / High Yield Epson 003 Ink Tanks / Official 1-Year Local Agent Warranty)

Streamline your home and office document workflow with the Epson EcoTank L3210 All-in-One Ink Tank Printer, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by an official 1-Year agent warranty. Featuring Epson Micro Piezo printhead technology, this compact 3-in-1 multi-function printer handles high-quality printing, scanning, and copying with ultra-low running costs. Delivers crisp black text and vibrant color photos at resolutions up to 5760 x 1440 dpi, fast print speeds up to 33 ppm, high-yield Epson 003 ink bottle support, and seamless Hi-Speed USB 2.0 desktop connectivity.

Printing TechnologyMicro Piezo Piezo-Electric Printhead
Nozzle Configuration180 Nozzles Black, 59 Nozzles per Color (Cyan, Magenta, Yellow)
Minimum Droplet Size3 pl (with Variable-Sized Droplet Technology)
Maximum Printing Resolution5760 x 1440 dpi
Draft Print Speed (A4)Up to 33 ppm (Black) / Up to 15 ppm (Color)

First Page Out TimeApprox. 10 sec (Black) / Approx. 16 sec (Color)
Photo Default Speed (10x15 cm)Approx. 69 sec per photo (Bordered) / Approx. 90 sec per photo (Borderless)
Copy Speed (A4)Up to 7.0 ipm (Black) / 1.7 ipm (Color) | Maximum Copy Size: A4, Letter

Scanner Bit Depth48-bit Input, 24-bit Output (Color)

Paper Tray CapacitiesInput: Up to 100 sheets Plain Paper (80g/m²), 20 sheets Premium Glossy Photo Paper
Output: Up to 30 sheets Plain Paper, 20 sheets Premium Glossy Photo Paper
Supported Paper SizesA4, A5, A6, B5, C6 (Envelope), DL (Envelope), No. 10 (Envelope), Letter, 10 x 15 cm, 13 x 18 cm, Legal (Maximum Size: 215.9 x 1200 mm)
Connectivity InterfaceHi-Speed USB 2.0 (Non-Wi-Fi Model)
Operating System CompatibilityWindows XP / Vista / 7 / 8 / 8.1 / 10 / 11, Windows Server, Mac OS X 10.6.8 or later
Ink Bottle Yields (Epson 003)Black Ink Bottle (003): Up to 4,500 Pages
Color Ink Bottles (003 C/M/Y): Up to 7,500 Pages (Composite Yield)

Dimensions & WeightDimensions (W x D x H): 375 x 347 x 179 mm | Net Weight: 3.9 kg
